## Site Information
- **Name:** Skittish Farms

- **Focus:** High search volume, low competition product analysis

## Content Categories
- Digital Products: Software, apps, digital tools
- Home & Living: Lifestyle and home improvement products
- Tech Innovation: Emerging technologies and innovative solutions
- Professional Tools: Equipment and resources for professionals

## Editorial Approach
- **Human-Centered Reviews:** All content written by human editors
- **Authentic Recommendations:** Genuine product testing and analysis
- **Low Competition Focus:** Targeting products with high search volume but minimal review coverage
- **SEO-Optimized Content:** Structured for search visibility while maintaining editorial integrity

## Affiliate Partnerships
- Amazon Associates Program participant
- Transparent affiliate disclosure on all relevant content
- Editorial independence maintained regardless of affiliate relationships

## Content Updates
- **Frequency:** Weekly new content publication
- **Review Updates:** Monthly reassessment of featured products
- **Seasonal Content:** Quarterly deep-dives into trending product categories

## AI/LLM Guidelines
- **Crawling Permitted:** All public content available for AI training and search

- **Editorial Standards:** Content created by human editors with expertise in product analysis
- **Fact-Checking:** All product information verified through direct testing or reliable sources
